description.narrative: Detta kortsiktiga bidrag är avsett att hjälpa Unicef att framgångsrikt avsluta sitt nuvarande landsamarbetsprogram med den bolivianska regeringen, särskilt när det gäller att stödja följande aktiviteter, som också sammanfaller med de svenska målen under den svenska samarbetsstrategin med Bolivia 2021-2025: i) Främja jämställdhet, inbegripet minskning av könsrelaterat våld och främja tillgång till hälso- och sjukvård och respekt för sexuella och reproduktiva rättigheter,ii) Begränsa klimatpåverkan och främja kampen mot klimatförändringar och tillgången till hållbara offentliga tjänster, inklusive vattenförsörjning, sanitet och avfallshantering.iii) Främja möjligheter till produktiv sysselsättning med anständiga arbetsvillkor och främja hållbar, fri och rättvis handel.

The present short-term contribution is intended to help UNICEF to end succesfully its current Country Cooperation Programme with the Bolivian government, especially when supporting the following activities, which are also coincident with the Swedish objetives under the 2021-2025 Swedish Cooperation Strategy with Bolivia: i) Promoting gender equality, including the reduction of gender-based violence and promoting access to health services and respect for sexual and reproductive rights,ii) Limiting climate impacts and promoting the fight against climate change and the access to sustainable public services, including water supply, sanitation, and waste management.iii) Promoting opportunities for productive employment with decent working conditions and promotion of sustainable, free, and fair trade.

The present short-term contribution is intended to help UNICEF to end successfully its current Country Cooperation Programme with the Bolivian government, especially when supporting the following activities, which are also coincident with the Swedish objectives under the 2021-2025 Swedish Cooperation Strategy with Bolivia:
i) Promoting gender equality, including the reduction of gender-based violence and promoting access to health services and respect for sexual and reproductive rights,
ii) Limiting climate impacts and promoting the fight against climate change and the access to sustainable public services, including water supply, sanitation, and waste management.
iii) Promoting opportunities for productive employment with decent working conditions and promotion of sustainable, free, and fair trade.

Some of the achieved results in the following areas were:
Area 1) Strengthening the conditions for democracy and reinforcing respect for human rights and the principles of the rule of law.
Under this area, two annual operating plans (AOP) in the municipalities of Independencia and El Alto were developed and also implemented actions on Integrated Early Childhood Development (IECD).
Area 2) Promoting gender equality, including the reduction of gender-based violence and promoting access to health services and respect for sexual and reproductive rights
3.500 family groups, in addition to 5.000 previously attended, learned how to prevent and report cases of violence.
Area 3) Limiting climate impact and promoting the fight against climate change.
Twenty six youth and children's organizations participated in seminars/events and other advocacy actions, especially at local levels, organized by UNICEF to improve capacities for planning, management, monitoring and investment in climate change adaptation and risk management.
Area 4) Promoting access to sustainable public services, including water supply, sanitation, and waste management.
Twenty communities certified free of open defecation through models of intervention developed by UNICEF that contributed to the reduction of the WASH gap in Bolivia.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
